title: OAuth2 Authentication (OAuthProvider + account re-auth)
description: Implement OAuthProvider as a drop-in IAuthProvider replacement for v2. Activates the account re-auth command stub from v1. Uses PKCE flow via Zoho OAuth API — no browser window, no redirect URL, no local HTTP server required at any point. OAuth client_id and client_secret are compile-time constants.
prerequisiteState: All v1 stories (1-8) completed. IAuthProvider, PatAuthProvider, AccountStore, and account commands all exist.
goal: account add --auth-type oauth triggers the PKCE flow and stores the OAuth token in the OS keychain under 'zapi-cli:<name>:oauth'. account re-auth --name <n> refreshes the token and sets needs_reauth=false.
scope: Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Auth/OAuthProvider.cs implementing IAuthProvider; OAuth client_id and client_secret must be compile-time constants (internal sealed class fields) — never user-supplied or runtime-configurable
OAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync: stores OAuth token to keychain under 'zapi-cli:<accountName>:oauth'
OAuthProvider.GetTokenAsync: retrieves token from keychain; throws AUTH_FAILURE (exit 2) if missing or expired

account add --auth-type oauth: triggers PKCE flow; --token flag not accepted (INVALID_ARGS if supplied); initiates Zoho OAuth device/terminal flow; fetches email via user-info API for ZohoCorp check; stores token via OAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync
account re-auth --name <n>: exchanges refresh token via Zoho OAuth API; updates token in keychain; sets account.NeedsReauth = false in accounts.json
Update AccountAddSettings Validate() to allow --auth-type oauth (was previously rejected in v1)
Update AccountReAuthCommand to implement the full OAuth exchange (was a stub in v1)
Register OAuthProvider and update DI to select IAuthProvider implementation based on account token_type

Unit tests: OAuthProvider.GetTokenAsync returns token from InMemoryKeychainProvider with 'zapi-cli:<name>:oauth' key; account re-auth sets needs_reauth=false in AccountStore; OAuth client_id/client_secret not configurable by user
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
account add --auth-type oauth triggers PKCE flow and stores token at 'zapi-cli:<name>:oauth' in the keychain
account re-auth --name work exchanges token via Zoho OAuth API and sets needs_reauth=false
api call on an account with token_type='oauth' uses OAuthProvider.GetTokenAsync
OAuth client_id and client_secret are compile-time constants — no environment variable, config file, or user flag can change them
No browser window, redirect URL, or local HTTP server is required at any point in the OAuth flow
contextForAgent: Read ADR-0002 for the IAuthProvider design — OAuthProvider is the v2 drop-in that requires no changes to ApiClient or any command class. The compile-time client_id/client_secret requirement is specified in ADR-0002 and is non-negotiable. The PKCE flow should use Zoho's device/terminal authorization endpoint to avoid any browser dependency. Tokens are stored under the ':oauth' suffix in the keychain.

openItems.defaultAssumption: Use Zoho's device authorization endpoint if available, or a terminal-based PKCE flow where the user enters a code. No local redirect server. Consult Zoho OAuth API docs for the exact endpoint.
